primary.usage: Primary actions, current active tabs, primary KPI numbers. Limit usage to avoid overwhelming the screen. It should act as a 'signal' color.

secondary.usage: Headings, high-contrast structural elements, sidebar background (optional, though white is preferred), heavy typography.

background.usage: Global application background. Adds a subtle coolness that feels clean and modern.

surface.usage: Cards, modals, dropdowns, sidebar, and top navbar. Must contrast sharply with the slate-50 background using borders.

border.usage: Sharp 1px solid borders for all widgets, grid items, and separators. No soft shadows; rely on borders for definition.

typography.tension_strategy: Since Inter is mandatory, create tension through extreme weight contrast: use font-black (900) for large KPI numbers and section headers, and font-medium (500) for body text. Use wide tracking (tracking-widest) for overlines and tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for big metrics.

layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed h-screen bg-white border-r border-slate-200.
layout.top_navbar: h-16 fixed top-0 left-64 right-0 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200 z-40.

grid_system.mode: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
grid_system.behavior: Dense, highly structured. Every pixel is utilized. No jagged bottoms. Use flex-col and h-full on cards to ensure they stretch evenly.

surface_styles.cards: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
surface_styles.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for the sticky top navbar (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200) or modal scrims (bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm).

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-blue-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-300 font-semibold rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent
components.badges: px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
components.tables: w-full text-left text-sm text-slate-600. Headers must be uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs text-slate-500. Rows separated by border-b border-slate-100.

image_urls.description: Abstract geometric blue slate pattern for the login screen background.
Modern office meeting room for Browse Resources grid.
Spacious conference room for Browse Resources grid.
Architectural floor plan blueprint for Floor Map view.

media.usage_rules: Never use generic placeholders. Use the provided images for respective sections. Add subtle bg-black/10 overlays if text needs to be placed over them.

motion.hover: Subtle border color shifts (border-slate-200 to border-blue-400) and small lifts (-translate-y-[2px]) on interactive cards.
motion.page_transition: Simple opacity fades. Avoid heavy motion in enterprise tools to maintain speed.
motion.data_loading: Use skeleton loaders with pulse animation (animate-pulse bg-slate-200) mimicking the exact shape of the missing data, rather than spinning wheels.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially gray muted text (text-slate-500), maintains at least 4.5:1 ratio against its background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's requested colors: Primary (#2563EB), Secondary (#0F172A), Background (#F8FAFC).
Strictly use the Inter font, but apply E1 tension rules: use font-black for major KPIs and font-medium for standard text to avoid generic flatness.
Layout is fixed: Sidebar on the left, Top Navbar spanning the remaining width. Main content padded properly to avoid being hidden behind fixed elements.
Use Lucide React (lucide-react) for all icons.
For Analytics Dashboard, use Recharts with stroke colors matching the app's palette (blue-600, slate-900, slate-300).
For Calendar View, utilize react-big-calendar styled with Tailwind to match the app's clean, border-heavy aesthetic.
For the Floor Map, use the provided architectural blueprint image combined with absolute-positioned HTML overlay markers (pins or selectable zones).
Do NOT use generic card components everywhere if it creates a 'boxed' feeling. Rely on raw HTML/Tailwind borders and grid structures for data density.
Implement 'data-testid' on all interactive elements without fail.
